report: USDA FAS Grain and Feed Annual, Turkiye, TU2025-0015
sourceMethod: Public PDF text read via the web reader; tables transcribed. Direct executor PDF preservation failed with tunnel 403 after the successful public read. Original PDF is not retained and no publisher-file hash is claimed.

records.label: 小麦（PSDの品目基準）
records.basisNote: MYは6月開始。TYは7月開始で、MYの需給帯へ混ぜない。PSD小麦と、QCL原穀・FBS小麦製品群・小麦粉実重量の対応換算はここでは行わない。

records.label: 大麦（PSDの品目基準）
records.basisNote: MYは6月開始、TYは10月開始。MYとTYの輸出入を交換しない。飼料・残差を全て飼料摂取と呼ばず、FSIを全て食用と呼ばない。

records.label: 米（精米換算）
records.basisNote: MYは9月開始。TYは1月開始。需給は精米換算で、813千MTの籾生産は別の参考行。籾・精米を加算せず、利用・残差を実際の食用消費にしない。

flourExports.product: 小麦粉（原穀換算ではない製品重量）
flourExports.scope: Turkiye national exports to all foreign destinations; not extra-regional exports. Eight named destinations plus the publisher Other row; not a complete country matrix.
flourExports.unresolved: Other is not split into destinations inside/outside the editorial 20-country scope. No raw-wheat/flour conversion or final-use allocation is available. The report attributes the trade table to the Turkish Statistics Institute.

limits: No same-vintage World production or complete same-product destination matrix; keep as an independent national marketing-year reference.
No future official-column zero placeholders or New Post estimates are selected.
Domestic use is reported by the source, not production minus exports. Imports and carried stocks are included; re-exports are not allocated to domestic harvest.
FSI combines food, seed and industrial uses; feed includes residuals. Rice consumption includes residuals.
MY and TY periods, milled rice and paddy, PSD wheat and flour product mass remain separate.
